name: Easy-Bake Treats!
summary: Another way to have fun with EASY-BAKE? The EASY-BAKE Treats! app let’s you make, bake, decorate, eat and share yummy virtual cakes, cupcakes, cookies, cake pops, pizza and pretzels right from your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch. Pick your mix, fill the pan with batter and water, mix it all together, choose an oven and slide the pan into the virtual EASY-BAKE Ultimate Oven to cook. Shake your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch to get your treats out of the pan and then choose from an amazing number of delicious frostings, candy toppings or pizza toppings to create your perfect virtual treat. Fill the decorating pen with any frosting and create amazing designs. You can add candles to your cakes and cupcakes too! Candles can be lit and re-lit for even more fun! Blow into your device or shake the device to blow out your candles. Once you’ve baked and decorated your treats, you can show off and share your delicious virtual creations with your family and friends via email or Facebook. And of course you can eat them! You can even choose the perfect tablecloth and plate to serve your yummy treat!
